title: Power Apps: form fill assistance adds lookup, rich text and multi-select choice fields
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned field-type expansion from the documented behaviour of existing form fill assistance. The roadmap details, licensing statements and control references are supported; the description of rich text needs a small wording and citation correction.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to expand Power Apps model-driven app form fill assistance to lookup, rich text and multi-select choice fields.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to support lookup, rich text, and multi-select choice fields, helping users complete more of their forms with AI-powered suggestions and less manual entry.

claims.quote:

claims.fix: Replace 'rich text fields hold longer free-form content' with 'rich text fields allow formatted text' and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/rich-text-editor-control. The source supports formatted text, not a comparative claim about length.
